description: CMSF-00 extends draft-ietf-moq-warp-01 (WARP Streaming Format), which is not included. Its catalog example writes version as a Number and puts each track's header in initData; these vectors cover only what CMSF-00 defines. Object vectors read a cmaf Object against its header; timeline vectors cover the SAP Type timeline, whose Location shape CMSF-00 shows only in its 3.6.2 example.
